select pa.*,g.goods_name,s.supplier_name,u.nick_name from sale_order as pa inner join goods as g on g.goods_id = pa.goods_id inner join supplier as s on s.supplier_id = g.supplier_id inner join sys_user as u on u.user_id = pa.sale_user where 1=1
and g.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parm.goodsName},'%')
and s.supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parm.supplierName},'%')
and u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parm.nickName},'%')
order by pa.create_time desc
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM sale_order GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month asc limit 10
select g.goods_name as name ,SUM(sale_count) as value from sale_order as s inner join goods as g on g.goods_id = s.goods_id GROUP BY g.goods_id,g.goods_name ORDER BY value desc
select u.nick_name as name, SUM(sale_count) as value from sale_order as s inner join sys_user as u on u.user_id = s.sale_user GROUP BY s.sale_user ORDER BY value DESC limit 10
